exposure: Parental HPV status (genital, oral, semen samples)
outcome: Newborn HPV status (oral, genital, umbilical samples)
cohort: 321 mothers, 134 fathers, and their 321 newborn offspring from the Finnish Family HPV study.
finding: Statistically significant genotype-specific HPV concordance was observed between mothers and their newborns for several HPV types, and between fathers and newborns for HPV-6 and HPV-31, suggesting vertical HPV transmission.
